parameters.name: Administrator
parameters.description: The ID of the collection administrator. This parameter is valid only for the album type. Default value: the current user ID.

parameters.name: CreateUser
parameters.description: The user ID of the creator. This parameter is valid only for the album type. Default value: the current user ID.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The collection description. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The collection name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Valid values:

 - Asc (default)
 - Desc

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ParentId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent node collection object.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. Valid values:

 - Id (default)
 - Name: name.
 - CreateUser: creator ID.
 - CreateTime: creation time.
 - ModifyTime: modification time.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The collection type. Valid values:

 - Category: category.
 - Album: data album.
 - AlbumCategory: album subcategory.
